claim: A test of the First Drafts method on a Latin text, not a new translation: Vitruvius already has complete English translations. Scored against M. H. Morgan's 1914 translation, the two renderings agree with him on 64% and 66% of the key terms, about the same as the Galen drafts against their human reference (63.5% and 66.4%).

description: Vitruvius, On Architecture, Book 3: a machine first draft in English with the Latin beside it, a test of the First Drafts method scored against Morgan's 1914 translation. Unverified.
